ALIAS_POLICY: No writable protected regular, directory, socket or duplicated alias at any allowed FD; number alone is not safety

FD0.MODE: O_RDONLY; fstat device/type must be independently verified

FD1.DIRECTION: write to independently bounded outside collector
FD1.OWNER: qualified outside collector same authorized nonprivileged context

FD2.DESTINATION: same combined capture allocation with parent exit tag charged
FD2.DIRECTION: write to independently bounded outside collector

OTHER_FDS: All >=3 closed before requested prlimit exec; internal exec-error pipe must be CLOEXEC and not persist into target
RACE_POLICY: Caller owns fixed pipe endpoints through fork/exec, no concurrent close/dup2/reopen mutation; no reliance only on pre-fork enumeration or non-atomic CLOEXEC setting
